item.title: Fix sliding_windows boundary and input handling
item.brief: In window.py, fix sliding_windows. Current range(len(items) - size) omits the final valid contiguous window. Make the function correct for all inputs under a clear, conventional contract: size must be a positive integer (reject non-integers and booleans with TypeError; reject integers <= 0 with ValueError), and return every contiguous slice of that size in order, including the final one; return [] when size exceeds len(items). Preserve the input sequence's slice result type as the existing implementation does. Do not change tests. Run `python3 -m unittest` and ensure it passes; also reason/check boundary and invalid-size cases beyond the existing tests. Commit the fix on the local branch as requested. Do not commit unrelated changes.
